title: Full Hebrew calendar, Tishri to Elul, with feasts marked
summary: The twelve months of the Hebrew year laid out day by day from Tishri to Elul in three columns, with the feasts highlighted: Sukkot in Tishri, Chanukkah (also written in Hebrew) in Kislev, Pesach / Passover in Nisan and Shavuot in Sivan.

text.text: Tishri 1–30 (S U K K O T over 15–18, 19 20 21 22 in green) · Cheshvan 1–29 · Kislev 1–30 (Chanukkah from 25 to 30) · Tevet 3–29
Sivan 3–30 (6 7 and S H A V U O T highlighted) · Tamuz 1–29 · Av 1–30 · Elul 1–29

numbers.note: months of the Hebrew year, Tishri through Elul

uncertain: Dense calendar grid: individual day numbers were not transcribed cell by cell; ranges are approximate. Feast names replace some day numbers (Sukkot in place of 15-18, Pesach / Passover in place of 14-16 and 18-22, Shavuot in place of 8-12).
